items.name: 지면반력·제동 충격량
required: Synchronized calibrated force plates or validated instrumented mound
items.excludedProxy: Knee extension is not braking force.

items.name: 전신 무게중심 감속
required: Validated whole-body segment kinematics including relevant segments
items.excludedProxy: Pelvis center is not whole-body COM.

items.name: 관절 모멘트·파워·에너지 흐름
required: Validated segment coordinate frames and rotations
Synchronized physical time and calibrated length
items.excludedProxy: Angular-velocity ratios are not energy efficiency.

items.name: 팔꿈치·어깨 부하
required: Validated high-rate upper-limb orientation and anatomical joint axes
External forces and subject-specific inertial assumptions
Inverse dynamics compared against external ground truth
items.excludedProxy: Pose angle alone is not torque, tissue stress or injury risk.

items.name: 에너지 효율·운동사슬 종합 점수
required: Validated energy/power quantities and accounting boundary
items.excludedProxy: Peak order alone is not energy-transfer efficiency.

items.name: MVPI
required: Verifiable public formal definition and reproducible implementation
items.excludedProxy: No invented expansion, formula or score is implemented.
